title: Positive bias from the mean
statement: For every Boolean function $f$ on a finite sign cube, its positive bias equals $(1+\mathbb{E}[f])/2$, where the mean is taken after interpreting the output sign as the real number $+1$ or $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on a finite sign cube
